 Barcelona vs Real Madrid LIVE streaming, TV channel, kick-off time & where to watch LaLiga 2026-27
 By Rajarshi Shukla Follow Add as Preferred Source Rajarshi has been part of Khel Now since 2022, and he covers world football. Published at : October 26, 2026 at 12:52 AM (GMT+5:30) Modified at : October 26, 2026 at 12:52 AM (GMT+5:30) (Courtesy :  LaLiga Content Hub )
 Los Blancos are six points behind Barcelona. 
 Barcelona and Real Madrid meet again in Spain’s top flight. This El Clásico takes place at Camp Nou tonight.
 Barca have set the pace in LaLiga this season, winning all nine of their opening games to sit on 27 points, while Real are third in the division with 21 points.
 Barca will arrive at Sunday’s El Clasico having tasted their first defeat of the campaign, losing 4-2 to European winners Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League on Tuesday evening. It was a fantastic game between two top sides.
 Barcelona haven’t lost to Real Madrid at home since October 2023, with their previous two defeats against Los Blancos coming at the Bernabeu in LaLiga.
 Real Madrid, meanwhile, are on the back of a 4-1 triumph against RB Leipzig in the Champions League, while they also defeated Sevilla by the same scoreline in LaLiga last weekend.
 Real Madrid have four games before the upcoming international break, at Barca, Racing de Santander and Valencia in the league and AEK Athens in Europe.
 Sunday’s fixture will see a host of world-class players go to war, including Barca’s Lamine Yamal and Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe.
 When and where will the Barcelona vs Real Madrid match take place?
 Catch Every Update, Anytime, Anywhere
 The game will start at 1:30 AM IST on Monday, October 26, 2026, at the Camp Nou, Barcelona, Spain.

 Where and how to live stream Barcelona vs Real Madrid in India?
 By tuning into the  FanCode app and website , fans in India can watch this LaLiga 2026-27 match live.
 Where and how to watch this LaLiga game live in the UK?
 Fans in the United Kingdom can watch this game live on Disney+ and Premier Sports.
 Where and how to watch Barcelona vs Real Madrid live in Spain?
 Fans in the host nation can view this LaLiga fixture live via  Movistar, DAZN  and  Teledeporte .
 Where do Real Madrid stand in the table?
 They are third in the table.
 What time will the game start?
 At 1:30 am IST, 26 October.
